The '''Sern sector''' was a [[sector]] that was represented in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] by [[Senator]] [[Bal-Cobor Sampurn]] during the [[High Republic Era]]<ref name="Acolyte Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> and Senator [[Fang Zar]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="The End of the Clone Wars" /> It contained [[Sern Prime]].<ref name="map" />
